description: Transaction decoder for Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum and Polygon: status, from, to, value, gas used, fee in native coin and USD, method name and arguments for common ERC20 calls, ERC20 transfers with symbols and amounts, and approvals. Use to confirm a payment landed or explain what a transaction did. Price $0.003 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"chain":"base","hash":"0x5514...","status":"success","from":"0x652a...","to":"0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913","method":{"name":"transfer"},"token_transfers":[{"symbol":"USDC","amount":"0.003"}],"fee_usd":0.0004}
name: tx_decode
